description: Provides a Flutter ChangeNotifier class 'MenuProvider' that manages fetching and caching menu categories and items, including offline support and analytics integration.

classes.name: MenuProvider
classes.description: A provider class for managing menu data with offline caching and event logging, supporting Flutter state management via ChangeNotifier.

methods.name: loadMenu
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the menu data, attempting offline cache first and falling back to demo seed data if cache is not available or an error occurs; also logs an event if 'initial' is true.

methods.name: itemsByCategory
methods.description: Returns a list of menu items filtered by a given category ID.

methods.name: itemById
methods.description: Retrieves a specific menu item by its unique ID, or null if not found.

methods.name: _seedDemoMenu
methods.description: Populates the provider with predefined demo menu categories and items for offline browsing and testing.
